setBoundary: Your age at the time you moved to the United States, using your current age and how long you’ve been in the U.S.
missingRisk: Your exact age at move-in could still depend on whether the “past five years” period started exactly relative to your birthday/arrival date; no specific move-in date is given.

items.why: States your current age (“32-year-old”) which is needed to compute your age at the time of moving.
Says you’ve been living in the United States for the past five years, providing the time-from-move information needed to infer your age at move time.
